cohort: 150 pregnant patients diagnosed with early onset pre-eclampsia at Niloufer Hospital.
finding: Early onset pre-eclampsia is associated with increased maternal and fetal morbidity and mortality, particularly at earlier gestational ages, with eclampsia and abruption being common maternal complications and IUFDs common fetal complications.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis was 31 weeks, with most women being 32-34 weeks at outcome, and significant morbidity/mortality observed at 24 and 28 weeks.
